test_title: PYST 20: SSC GD - GA & GK (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: A Judge of the Supreme Court submits his resignation to the President.
A Judge of the Supreme Court submits his resignation to the Prime Minister.
A Judge of the Supreme Court submits his resignation to the Vice-President.
A Judge of the Supreme Court submits his resignation to the Attorney-General.

solution:
The correct answer is __A Judge of the Supreme Court submits his resignation to the President.____ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

 
• Judges of the Supreme Court are appointed by the President under Article 124(2) of the Constitution. 
 
• A judge of the Supreme Court submits his resignation to the President of India.
